body:
`frontend/e2e/reader-notes.spec.ts:171` — *"reader notes (#325) › a note can be
written, survives a reload, is editable and removable"*, `[mobile]` project —
fails intermittently at line 199:

    Error: the noted highlight is repainted after a reload
    expect(received).toBe(expected)   Expected: 1   Received: 0

Landed today (`17c6ae125`, #1508, 11:28) with the notes feature.

WHY THIS IS A FLAKE AND NOT A REGRESSION — established by control, not inference:

  #1506 (ui/target-size-sc258) E2E at 15:46  -> PASS
  #1507 (ui/help-banner-theming) E2E 15:51   -> FAIL (3 retries, all fail)
  #1505 (ui/book-card-action-row) E2E 15:54  -> PASS
  #1507 re-run, same head, 16:05             -> FAIL again
  #1506 RE-RUN, HEAD UNCHANGED, 16:14        -> FAIL   <- the control

The same commit that passed at 15:46 fails at 16:14 with nothing changed. That
is the whole argument: a re-run on an unchanged head is what separates "this
branch broke it" from "this test is unreliable", and it inverted the conclusion.
Before that control the evidence looked damning for #1507 — two of three
branches on the same base passed, so the odd one out appeared responsible.

None of the three branches can reach the reader. #1506 touches TopBar/Account/
EditBook CSS; #1507 touches HelpBanner + tokens. The reader route is rendered
**outside the app shell** (`App.tsx:144`, "Full-screen reader — outside the app
shell (no sidebar/topbar)"), so `AnnouncementBanner` never mounts there, and
`--cwng-banner-h` exists only in `cps/templates/layout.html` — the classic UI,
not the SPA.

The three in-run retries are NOT independent evidence: they execute in the same
job on the same runner, so a resource-dependent failure takes all three and
looks like a hard reproduction. Only a fresh run on an unchanged head is a
control.

Note the failure is on `[mobile]` only and takes ~21s each attempt, i.e. it is
waiting for something that never arrives rather than asserting a wrong value —
`pageUntilNotedPainted` never finds the repainted mark. Ordering/timing between
the reload and the annotation fetch is the place to look.

Owner: the reader work (CWNG READER) shipped this feature and test today.
Second known flake alongside F-8b3e17 (test_1094 TestConversionDeadline) and
`sp2-display-options.spec.ts:61` "Customize panel can restore hidden Table
view", which showed the same profile earlier today.

resolution.note: Root-caused and fixed by CWNG READER in #1509 (d239befa3), two causes: a fixed 5s sleep after page.reload() replaced with a condition-based wait on the same budget as the first open, and a stride partition (i % SPEC_SLOTS === offset) that selected nothing for higher offsets when only 3 EPUBs clear the size floor — replaced with rotation. Residual, not claimed closed: fullyParallel spreads 6 spec-project combos over 3 books, so two specs can still share one and clear each other's fixtures; the tell is a note read back with another run's timestamp.

title: reader-notes repaint-after-reload is flaky and reds unrelated PRs
